mapper.select: SELECT * FROM practice_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(correct), 0) AS correct FROM practice_record
user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(finish_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(correct) AS correct FROM practice_record
user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND finish_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 13 DAY)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(finish_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO practice_record (user_id, name, mode, category_id, total, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{mode}, #{categoryId}, #{total}, 0)
